mechanism_narrative: A positive month-over-month change in CPIAUCSL (inflation) signals rising price pressures that prompt central banks to maintain accommodative monetary policy, supporting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL month-over-month change is positive, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, it signals an active monetary tightening cycle that increases discount rates on equity cash flows, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the Rank IC over a 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low UNRATE and high PAYEMS growth signals a tight labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: doc:Labor Market Tightness and Equity Returns
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE < 4.5% and PAYEMS growth > 0.5% monthly, or the Rank IC for the interaction term falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.0%), labor market weakness signals economic distress and potential recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 4.5%, it signals a tight labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: doc:Labor Market Tightness and Equity Performance
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE < 4.5%, or the Rank IC over a 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A positive month-over-month change in INDPRO (industrial production) indicates expanding economic activity, which supports corporate profits and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO month-over-month change is positive, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in FEDFUNDS and elevated CPIAUCSL (above 200) signals aggressive monetary tightening to combat inflation, which typically triggers a sell-off in equities, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS rises and CPIAUCSL > 200, or the Rank IC for the interaction term falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high housing market activity regime (HOUST > 2000 thousand units), the robust housing sector signals strong consumer confidence and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where HOUST > 2000, or the Rank IC over a 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.
